lines: Again. Your footprints laid over the old road. Do you remember pulling three times before the sword came free?
The lion in the echo is angrier. Don't loosen your parry.
A corner of the tower fell. And you're still standing. …Hmph. Come in, have some tea.
If your techniques still have room to grow, the training's still open.
You saw through the mist too? Eyes grow before the sword does.
The tower is waiting. Don't be the fool who mistakes flame for firewood.
(Back turned) The gate opens for you.
There's mist to the southeast. Letters may be late — you shouldn't be.
You have an edge now. The lion in the sanctum doesn't listen to words. It listens to steel.
You're not going to prove you're strong. You're going to make it remember what it was supposed to guard.
Weakest of the company? The Sacred Lion is in the sanctum. If you're not here to die, raise your sword first.
Techniques aren't for looking at. They only grow when they land. Living to report beats a pretty medal.
